answer: Require each identity to carry a hardware attestation: one signed proof from a real trusted execution environment per chip. A sybil factory can spin up a thousand agents, but each fake still needs its own silicon, so no harbor shelters identities without a hardware passport. The delta between one honest laptop and a botnet vanishes: new chips cost real money, and each new inlet for fakes shows up in a public log where it can be rate-limited. Hardware roots get stolen too, and poorer regions cannot afford certified chips, so this buys friction, not immunity.
